This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 for 
the gas turbine control system 250 M.W. which must be performed on yearly bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng.Wael Ahmed Shoeib, 
tested by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Moustafa, revised by eng. Ashraf Farid Ali, accepted by eng. Adel Abd 
El-Kader El-Nagar 
approved by eng. El-Sherbiny Ismail I&C maintenance general manager and approved 
by eng. Ibrahim Hassan head sector of New Talkha power station

This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El gilil 
MDEPC quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
eng. Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.

items:
A 
 work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear 
 safety helmet, shoes
Turbine must be shut downed
Digital Ammeter
Screw Driver
PG 720 (PC)
Air cleaner

Review technical 
 reference materials and manufacture's manual

Review the light in 
 cabinet CJR01 (turbine control)

Review the temperature of cabinet 
 by check the fan and clean the fan
Check supply voltage (24 VDC)

Visual inspection of the cabinet, 
 incl CPU modules and terminals

Check cabling incl, shielding and 
 earthing

Check the 7-segment indicator for 
 error messages

Check CPU battery and change if 
 necessary

Connect PG 720 with master 
 processor

Check the required values for 
 turbine control valves
Disconnect the PG 720 (PC) from master processor
Close the cabinet CIR01

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 for 
the gas turbine control system 250 M.W. which must be performed on yearly bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng.Wael Ahmed Shoeib, 
tested by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Moustafa, revised by eng. Ashraf Farid Ali, accepted by eng. Adel Abd 
El-Kader El-Nagar 
approved by eng. El-Sherbiny Ismail I&C maintenance general manager and approved 
by eng. Ibrahim Hassan head sector of New Talkha power station
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El gilil 
MDEPC quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
eng. Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear 
 safety helmet, shoes
Turbine must be shut downed
Tools and Equipment
Digital Ammeter
Screw Driver
PG 720 (PC)
Air cleaner
Work to be carried out
Review technical 
 reference materials and manufacture's manual
Review the light in 
 cabinet CJR01 (turbine control)
Review the temperature of cabinet 
 by check the fan and clean the fan
Testing Procedures
Check supply voltage (24 VDC)
Visual inspection of the cabinet, 
 incl CPU modules and terminals
Check cabling incl, shielding and 
 earthing
Check the 7-segment indicator for 
 error messages
Check CPU battery and change if 
 necessary
Connect PG 720 with master 
 processor
Check the required values for 
 turbine control valves
Disconnect the PG 720 (PC) from master processor
Close the cabinet CIR01
